title: अध्याय २३

items.speaker: ऋषय ऊचुः
items.text:
ब्रूहि वामनमाहात्म्यमुत्पत्तिं च विशेषतः
यथा बलिर्नियमितो दत्तं राज्यं शतक्रतोः
items.tr:
brūhi vāmanamāhātmyamutpattiṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
yathā balirniyamito dattaṃ rājyaṃ śatakratoḥ

items.speaker: लोमहर्षण उवाच
items.text:
शृणुध्वं मुनयः प्रीता वामनस्य महात्मनः
उत्पत्तिं च प्रभावं च निवासं कुरुजाङ्गले
तदेव वंशं दैत्यानां शृणुध्वं द्विजसत्तमाः
यस्य वंशे समभवद् बलिर्वैरोचनिः पुरा
दैत्यानामादिपुरुषो हिरण्यकशिपुः पुरा
तस्य पुत्रो महातेजाः प्रह्लादो नाम दानवः
items.tr:
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ prītā vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ
utpattiṃ ca prabhāvaṃ ca nivāsaṃ kurujāṅgale
tadeva vaṃśaṃ daityānāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ
yasya vaṃśe samabhavad balirvairocaniḥ purā
daityānāmādipuruṣo hiraṇyakaśipuḥ purā
tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma dānavaḥ

items.text:
तस्माद् विरोचनो जज्ञे बलिर्जज्ञे विरोचनात्
हते हिरण्यकशिपौ देवानुत्साद्य सर्वतः
राज्यं कृतं च तेनेष्टं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
कृतयत्नेषु देवेषु त्रैलोक्ये दैत्यतां गते
जये तथा बलवतोर्मयशम्बरयोस्तथा
शुद्धासु दिक्षु सर्वासु प्रवृत्ते धर्मकर्मणि
items.tr:
tasmād virocano jajñe balirjajñe virocanāt
hate hiraṇyakaśipau devānutsādya sarvataḥ
rājyaṃ kṛtaṃ ca teneṣṭaṃ trailokye sacarācare
kṛtayatneṣu deveṣu trailokye daityatāṃ gate
jaye tathā balavatormayaśambarayostathā
śuddhāsu dikṣu sarvāsu pravṛtte dharmakarmaṇi

items.text:
संप्रवृत्ते दैत्यपथे अयनस्थे दिवाकरे
प्रह्लादशम्बरमयैरनुह्रादेन चैव हि
दिक्षु सर्वासु सुप्तासु गगने दैत्यपालिते
देवेषु मखशोभां च स्वर्गस्थां दर्शयत्सु च
प्रकृतिस्थे ततो लोके वर्त्तमाने च सत्पथे
अभावे सर्वपापानां धर्मभावे सदोत्थिते
items.tr:
saṃpravṛtte daityapathe ayanasthe divākare
prahlādaśambaramayairanuhrādena caiva hi
dikṣu sarvāsu suptāsu gagane daityapālite
deveṣu makhaśobhāṃ ca svargasthāṃ darśayatsu ca
prakṛtisthe tato loke varttamāne ca satpathe
abhāve sarvapāpānāṃ dharmabhāve sadotthite

items.text:
चतुष्पादे स्थिते धर्मे ह्यधर्मे पादविग्रहे
प्रजापालनयुक्तेषु भ्राजमानेषु राजसु
स्वधर्मसंप्रयुक्तेषु तथाश्रमनिवासिषु
अभिषिक्तोऽसुरैः सर्वैर्दैत्यराज्ये बलिस्तदा
हृष्टेष्वसुरसंघेषु नदत्सु मुदितेषु च
अथाभ्युपगता लक्ष्मीर्बलिं पद्मान्तरप्रभा
items.tr:
catuṣpāde sthite dharme hyadharme pādavigrahe
prajāpālanayukteṣu bhrājamāneṣu rājasu
svadharmasaṃprayukteṣu tathāśramanivāsiṣu
abhiṣikto'suraiḥ sarvairdaityarājye balistadā
hṛṣṭeṣvasurasaṃgheṣu nadatsu muditeṣu ca
athābhyupagatā lakṣmīrbaliṃ padmāntaraprabhā

items.text:
पद्मोद्यतकरा देवी वरदा सुप्रवेशिनी
श्रीरुवाच
बले बलवतां श्रेष्ठ दैत्यराज महाद्युते
प्रीतास्मि तव भद्रं ते देवराजपराजये
यत्त्वया युधि विक्रम्य देवराज्यं पराजितम्
दृष्ट्वा ते परमं सत्त्वं ततोऽहं स्वयमागता
items.tr:
padmodyatakarā devī varadā supraveśinī
śrīruvāca
bale balavatāṃ śreṣṭha daityarāja mahādyute
prītāsmi tava bhadraṃ te devarājaparājaye
yattvayā yudhi vikramya devarājyaṃ parājitam
dṛṣṭvā te paramaṃ sattvaṃ tato'haṃ svayamāgatā

items.text:
नाश्चर्यं दानवव्याघ्र हिरण्यकशिपोः कुले
प्रसूतस्यासुरेन्द्र स्य तव कर्मेदमीदृशम्
विशेषितस्त्वया राजन् दैत्येन्द्र ः! प्रपितामहः
येन भुक्तं हि निखिलं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम्
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी लक्ष्मीर्दैत्यनृपं बलिम्
प्रविष्टा वरदा सेव्या सर्वदेवमनोरमा
items.tr:
nāścaryaṃ dānavavyāghra hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kule
prasūtasyāsurendra sya tava karmedamīdṛśam
viśeṣitastvayā rājan daityendra ḥ! prapitāmahaḥ
yena bhuktaṃ hi nikhilaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam
evamuktvā tu sā devī lakṣmīrdaityanṛpaṃ balim
praviṣṭā varadā sevyā sarvadevamanoramā

items.text:
तुष्टाश्च देव्यः प्रवराः ह्रीः कीर्तिर्द्युतिरेव च
प्रभा धृतिः क्षमा भूतिरृद्धिर्दिव्या महामतिः
श्रुतिःस्मृतिरिडा कीर्तिः शान्तिः पुष्टिस्तथा क्रिया
सर्वाश्चाप्सरसो दिव्या नृत्तगीतविशारदाः
प्रपद्यन्ते स्म दैत्येन्द्रं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्
प्राप्तमैश्वर्यमतुलं बलिना ब्रह्मवादिना
items.tr:
tuṣṭāśca devyaḥ pravarāḥ hrīḥ kīrtirdyutireva ca
prabhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā bhūtirṛddhirdivyā mahāmatiḥ
śrutiḥsmṛtiriḍā kīrtiḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistathā kriyā
sarvāścāpsaraso divyā nṛttagītaviśāradāḥ
prapadyante sma daityendraṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram
prāptamaiśvaryamatulaṃ balinā brahmavādinā

en_summary: In this part (the Greatness of the Lake section, though the closing line still names the Pulastya-Narada dialogue) the sages ask Lomaharshana to tell the greatness and birth of Vamana, and how Bali was held back and Indra's kingdom given back. Lomaharshana tells them of Vamana's birth, power and home in Kurujangala, and first of the demon line into which Bali, son of Virochana, was born. Hiranyakashipu was the first man of the demons; his son was Prahlada, Prahlada's son Virochana, and Virochana's son Bali. After Hiranyakashipu was killed, Bali drove out the gods everywhere and ruled the three worlds as he wished, with the mighty Maya and Shambara winning victories. Under the demons the world was in good order: all directions were clear, dharma was practised, dharma stood on all four feet and adharma on only one, kings protected their people, people of the life stages kept their own duties, and there was no sin. All the demons crowned Bali as king of the demons. Then Lakshmi, shining like a lotus and holding a lotus, came to Bali and said: 'Bali, best of the strong, I am pleased with you for defeating the king of the gods; seeing your great strength I have come of my own will. It is no wonder that one born in Hiranyakashipu's family does such deeds; you have even surpassed your great-grandfather, who enjoyed all the three worlds.' With these words she entered into Bali. The other goddesses were also pleased and came to him: Modesty, Fame, Splendour, Light, Firmness, Patience, Prosperity, Wealth, Intelligence, Scripture, Memory, Ida, Peace, Nourishment and Action, and all the heavenly Apsaras skilled in dance and song. So Bali, who spoke of Brahman, gained the three worlds and matchless lordship.
